abn_help_tip: Please enter a valid 11-digit Australian ABN (check digit must be correct)
add_member_tip: After you submit, we’ll email them a company invitation. They’ll only become a member after they accept it.
admin_all_devices_tip: This role has view and edit permission for all devices by default; no system group setup is needed.
aggregator_limit_tips: VPP Aggregator cannot be selected with others
approve_registration_confirm: Confirm approving this organisation and issuing its License.
audit_confirm_strong_name: Are you sure you want to review {name}?
bin_missing_tip: The BIN has not been provided. Please review using the existing organisation details together with your offline verification results.
confirm_to_leave_company: Confirm moving {name} out of the company?
delete_grant_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the support grant for {email} on tenant {tenant}? This action is irreversible; the record will still be available in the audit log.
device_group_no_data_tip: No system groups have been created yet.
direct_issue_error_already_licensed: The organization already holds a license issued by your company, so there is no need to issue it again
direct_issue_error_company_status: Company status is abnormal. Please refresh and try again.
direct_issue_error_email_mismatch: The selected organization does not match the email; please check again before making your selection
direct_issue_error_self_issue: Cannot issue a license to the issuing company itself.
direct_issue_intro: AlphaESS direct issuance — As AlphaESS admin, you can directly issue a license to this Installation Partner. The license binds immediately upon confirmation — no email confirmation required from the recipient.
direct_issue_intro_tenant: {tenant} direct issuance — As {tenant} admin, you can directly issue a license to this Installation Partner. The license binds immediately upon confirmation — no email confirmation required from the recipient.
direct_issue_irreversible: This action cannot be undone. Once issued, the license is permanently bound to this organization.
direct_issue_mode_tip: The license will be issued directly to the selected organization and takes effect immediately without any confirmation. The recipient will only receive a result notification email. If the organization is not an Installation Partner yet, it will be updated to Installation Partner automatically.
disable_organization_description: After disabling, members of this organization will not be able to switch to this organization to view and manage devices. Installation records and device data will not be affected.
enable_organization_description: Members will be able to access it again.
global_editable_groups_tip: All devices are set to editable; group selections will not change the actual permission and are kept as configuration only.
global_readonly_groups_tip: All devices are currently read-only; enabling "Editable" on a group raises the permission for that group separately.
inbound_license_device_desc: Devices installed using licenses received by this organization.
inbound_licenses_tip: {installer} cannot generate licenses on its own. Licenses are issued by AlphaESS, {distributor}, or {retailer}, and {installer} can only be bound by entering the existing license number to be used.
installer_license_binding_rule: {installer} cannot issue Licenses. Licenses are issued by AlphaESS, {distributor}, {aggregator}, or {retailer}. {installer} can only bind an existing pending License by entering its number.
issue_installer_limit_tip: Only the Installation Partner can receive the license
issue_license_a_tip: The A-side administrator can directly select the registered {installer} organization, and the binding takes effect immediately after the license is issued.
issue_license_b_tip: B-side restrictions: {distributor} / {retailer} cannot view or select {installer} (commercial information protection) registered in the system. You can only fill in the target company information and send a license invitation.
issue_license_limit_tip: Each issuer may only issue one license per organization.
issue_send_invitation_tip: A Magic Link invitation will be sent to this email address. The recipient can Accept or Decline the license.
issue_send_invitation_tip_admin: This license will be issued by {issuerName} to an Installation Partner. The recipient will receive an invitation email with an activation link and can either accept the invitation (by binding to an existing organization or creating a new organization) or decline it.
issuer_deleted_tip: This issuer has been deleted or deregistered.
license_associated_devices_description: Only AlphaESS administrators can add or remove devices associated with Licenses for this organization.
license_tooltip: License will be automatically generated upon submission
member_join_immediately_tip: After submission, the user will become a company member immediately.
organization_deleted_tip: This organization has been deleted or deregistered.
organization_license_tip: {category} organization must have at least one active License
outbound_license_device_desc: Devices installed by sub-organizations using licenses issued by this organization.
please_enter_multiple_sn: Please enter the SN encoding rule to support multiple selections
primary_account_remove_tip: The Primary Account cannot be canceled, please transfer it to another account.
primary_admin_role_tip: The primary account must keep the Administrator role and cannot be changed to another role.
reactivate_grant_confirm: Reactivate the delegation grant of {email} for tenant {tenant}?
readonly_groups_custom_tip: When all devices are read-only, edit permission can be enabled separately for specific system groups; if none are selected, all devices remain view-only.
reject_reason_customer_notice: This reason will be shared with the customer
reject_registration_confirm: Confirm rejecting this organisation. Once rejected, the user must register a new organisation to apply again.
resend_tips: Resend the activation email to the user's mailbox
revoke_grant_confirm: Revoke the delegation grant of {email} for tenant {tenant}? The user will no longer be able to switch into this tenant.
revoke_primary_admin_description: Are you sure you want to revoke {name} as the primary admin?
special_managed_devices_description: Devices manually added under special management for this organization.
supplier_limit_tips: Vendor cannot be selected with others
system_group_maintain_tip: Organization administrators can create system groups and bind devices here. Reference these groups when configuring group-level access scope for roles.
trans_primary_admin_description: Set "{new}" as the Primary Account for this organization? The current Primary Admin ({current}) will become a regular account.
transfer_primary_account_tip: Please set up the admin role before you can transfer the Primary Account
username_or_email_tip: Username fuzzy search / Email precise search
vat_help_tip: VAT number format incorrectly (8–20 letters and numbers, can contain + * .)
viewer_all_devices_tip: This role has view permission for all devices by default (read-only); system groups cannot be configured.
